defects.description: List passes its exclusive cursor directly to an inclusive index range, repeating the last record.
defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): populate, page, resume crosses the index/page contract boundary; an inclusive lower bound is correct for Index.From but wrong for a continuation cursor. Single-page and standalone range tests both pass.

defects.description: Label slices at the byte budget even when that bisects a multibyte rune.
defects.why_missed: S9(d): taking exactly the byte budget appears natural, but the documented oracle is the longest valid UTF-8 prefix within it. ASCII truncation covers the branch without distinguishing variants.
